# Semantic Layer evidence: search, graph, brain, brainstore

Scope and caveats first:
- **Org context has no Semantic Layer entry.** `librarian admin config get org-context` (roster dated 2026-04-22) lists no such team, charter or channel. The only related line is "Evis Drenova: Peregrine (semantic search)". It also omits people who show up heavily in this area (Suhaan Thayyil, jdx, Karthik, krk, Abhi Singh), so it is stale here.
- **Time-scoped queries were flaky.** About 46 queries ran; most `--since` and both `--author` queries returned HTTP 504 or empty. Coverage of the last 12 months therefore comes mainly from unscoped queries filtered by date.
- **RFD-031 body was not retrieved.** Only the trail stub and Slack mentions came back.
- Slack thread links are abbreviated as `C…/p…`; full form is `https://slack.com/archives/<channel>/<p-id>`.

## 0. Team, ownership, channels (from sources, not org context)

- **Channel:** #area-semantic-layer (C0B9CUDC4G5). A separate brain channel (C0BGAES8YSH, called "ex-brain channel" by Suhaan) was merged into it and archived on 2026-09-29. Slack, Alex and Evis, 2026-09-28/29: C0B9CUDC4G5/p1790644191430789, C0BGAES8YSH/p1790639680098469.
- **Meeting:** a "semantic area call" exists (Evis, 2026-10-10, C0B9CUDC4G5/p1791616983280609).
- **Labels and prefixes:** a `semantic-layer` Linear label exists (ENT-3763). Search tickets are ENT-* with `[semantic-search]` / `[code-search]` title prefixes. Brain, graph and brainstore tickets are mostly COR-*.
- **People (inferred from authorship, not a stated roster):**
  - Evis Drenova: peregrine/code search, semantic search, brainstore, brain since October 2026, RFD-031.
  - Alisha Kawaguchi: entire-search semantic pipeline.
  - Suhaan Thayyil: entire-graph and entire-brain creator, graphmark.
  - Thomas (ashtom): co-creator and reviewer of graph, brain-bench/graphmark.
  - Alex: brain docs and schema tickets COR-2000 and COR-2007, Linear project hygiene.
  - Occasional: jdx (search-skill adoption), krk (issue memory), Abhi Singh (COR-2216), Karthik.
- **Framing:**
  - Marvin describes brain as "Entire's Semantic Reasoning Layer — durable memory that agents read from and write to" (Slack 2026-07-08, C0BA2391FPZ/p1783526033934659).
  - Marketing calls graph + brain "Continuous Memory" (Slack #devrel 2026-09-29, C0AQHKCNCPM/p1790711785402479).
  - Evis's tool model (Slack 2026-10-03, C0B9CUDC4G5/p1790989468285289): semantic search finds context in transcripts and returns checkpoints; brain retains structured memories; peregrine retrieves code and symbols across repos; graph adds structural code relationships.
- **Overlap analysis** (Suhaan, Slack 2026-07-10, C0BGAES8YSH/p1783651246716539): near-zero overlap between brain and entire-search; the one real duplication is tree-sitter extractors in both peregrine and entire-sem; proposal that entire-sem become peregrine's external symbol producer.
- **Earlier use of the term:** librarian PR #29 (2026-04-21, https://github.com/entirehq/librarian/pull/29) framed Librarian as "Entire's Semantic Reasoning Layer". ENT-7 (2025-11-20) used "semantic layer" for checkpoint metadata.

## 1. Entire search (semantic search = `entirehq/entire-search`; code search = `entirehq/peregrine`)

**What it is**
- Semantic search: hybrid BM25 + vector search over checkpoints, sessions, commits and transcripts. Turbopuffer vectors, Cohere `embed-v4.0` plus `rerank-v4.0-fast`. Split into indexer and query-serve on EKS, fed by NATS `repo_refs_v1`.
- Code search: peregrine, a trigram index (Rust) with indexes in S3, plus symbols, usages and hover.
- Surfaces: entire.io /search, CLI `entire search`, MCP `search_entire`.

**Timeline**
- 2026-02-26, Slack #area-data-plane (C09V780RGGN/p1772132868899239): Turbopuffer intro; Evis proposes vector search across checkpoints and codebase. This is the origin.
- 2026-03-05, Slack #progress (C09MB3TPBFF/p1772692729977049): semantic + BM25 over full transcripts working, real-time embedding pipeline via webhooks.
- 2026-03-18, Slack #progress (C09MB3TPBFF/p1773813075060609): semantic search PR entire.io#1056 and Search RFD (company-knowledge PR #57).
- 2026-04-06, Slack #ships (C0APUHMSG6P/p1775518657000599): `entire search` in the CLI, internal only.
- 2026-04-09/10: PR entire.io#1424 "make search GA", reverted next day by #1434 back under flag after quality pushback (Slack #entire, C095MMM9YHG/p1775815277836809).
- 2026-05-15, PR entire.io#1969: embeddings switched from OpenAI to Cohere embed-v4.0 (about 40% faster). #1957 removed DB hydration; search had been taking 85–119s.

- 2026-06-18: entire-search trail #4 adds EntireDB as the indexing data source.
- 2026-06-25 to 08-12: semantic search v3 (Cloudflare worker, org namespaces) to v4 (EKS, per-repo namespaces) migration: ENT-930, 934, 935, 936, 970, 1014. - 2026-07-02, PR cli#1616 (ENT-990): code search in the CLI (`entire search --code`) with multi-region fan-out and a TUI tab.
- 2026-07-08, Slack (C0B9CUDC4G5/p1783485157407169): "peregrine is now deployed across all 3 regions" (US, EU ENT-998, AU ENT-1060).

- 2026-10-29, ENT-3664 (Done): peregrine query tier becomes an LRU cache over S3. The 2026-10-26 launch wave (about 50x repo creation) grew the volume from 60% to 83% in 42h. Measured: 28,029 repos, 329.7 GiB; only 903 repos (3.2%) ever searched in 111 days; about 100–200 queries/day; p50 110 ms.

**Open plans and debates**
- ENT-841 (In Progress) and ENT-3946 (Backlog, 2026-11-10): index trails in semantic search; benchmark, then enable for the Entire org.
- ENT-1871 (Todo): one search path for /sessions, delete the Postgres fallback, single global header search.
- ENT-1482 (Backlog): self-hosted embedding and rerank to replace Cohere. Bedrock ruled out 2026-08-03.

- Debated: folding code snippets into semantic results added little lift (Evis, 2026-08-30, C0B9CUDC4G5/p1788062943867969). Semantic search "only valuable for cross repo search" versus ripgrep locally; Alex: "we need to get to the point where there are numbers" (2026-09-29, C0B9CUDC4G5/p1790670908007059). Tier-2 ANN-only results dropped (entire-search trail #86, 2026-07-30).

## 2. Entire graph (`entireio/entire-graph`, formerly `entire-sem`; benchmark `entirehq/graphmark`)

**What it is**
- A CLI plugin (`entire graph`) that builds an entity-level code graph (calls, dependencies, changed entities, impact) so agents find code with fewer tokens. Local only.
- Created by Suhaan with Thomas (Slack 2026-07-21, C095MMM9YHG/p1784658556706209). The repo is public (COR-2157).

**Timeline**

- COR-781, 784, 791, 794 (Todo, Suhaan, 2026-07-01): map graph snapshots into checkpoint metadata; MCP query by semantic entity; reasoning-record schema RFD; provenance graph.

## 3. Brain (`entireio/entire-brain`, CLI plugin `entire brain`)

**What it is**
- The memory layer for a repo: agents distill durable facts ("memories") from sessions and checkpoints, then `brief` / `recall` / `remember` them. Repo-scoped (Alex, 2026-09-29).
- Originated by Suhaan and Thomas. Evis took over the simplification and launch push from October 2026 (inferred from authorship).

**Timeline**
- 2026-07-08: Suhaan's "P1 shared/hosted brain" trail (server store, fact sync, remote MCP, multi-tenancy). A 10-part "P1 brain" PR stack on entire-api (#744–#750, 2026-08-20) and mcp PR #41 are still listed as open; the brainstore service appears to supersede them (inference).

## 1. Entire search (semantic search = `entirehq/entire-search`; code search = `entirehq/peregrine`)

**What it is**
- Semantic search: hybrid BM25 + vector search over checkpoints, sessions, commits and transcripts. Turbopuffer vectors, Cohere `embed-v4.0` plus `rerank-v4.0-fast`. Split into indexer and query-serve on EKS, fed by NATS `repo_refs_v1`.
- Code search: peregrine, a trigram index (Rust) with indexes in S3, plus symbols, usages and hover.
- Surfaces: entire.io /search, CLI `entire search`, MCP `search_entire`.

## 2. Entire graph (`entireio/entire-graph`, formerly `entire-sem`; benchmark `entirehq/graphmark`)

**What it is**
- A CLI plugin (`entire graph`) that builds an entity-level code graph (calls, dependencies, changed entities, impact) so agents find code with fewer tokens. Local only.
- Created by Suhaan with Thomas (Slack 2026-07-21, C095MMM9YHG/p1784658556706209). The repo is public (COR-2157).

## 3. Brain (`entireio/entire-brain`, CLI plugin `entire brain`)

**What it is**
- The memory layer for a repo: agents distill durable facts ("memories") from sessions and checkpoints, then `brief` / `recall` / `remember` them. Repo-scoped (Alex, 2026-09-29).

## 4. Brainstore (`entirehq/brainstore`, hosted team-memory service)
